steps.title: Position bolt catch in fixture
steps.description: Align and position the small bolt catch component into the lower receiver seated in the left fixture
key_points: Ensure proper alignment of pin hole

transcript.text: Right hand grasps a bolt catch from the blue bin beside the screw feeder
Both hands orient the bolt catch
Both hands place and seat the bolt catch into the fixture

steps.title: Grab hanging electric screwdriver
steps.description: Grasp the suspended electric torque screwdriver with the right hand

transcript.text: Right hand grasps and pulls down the hanging electric screwdriver towards the component

steps.title: Pick screw with screwdriver
steps.description: Insert magnetic bit of screwdriver into automatic screw feeder to retrieve a screw
key_points: Confirm screw is seated straight on magnetic bit

transcript.text: Right hand presses the electric screwdriver tip into the screw feeder opening to pick up a screw
Right hand lifts the electric screwdriver away from the screw feeder

steps.title: Drive screw into receiver
steps.description: Drive the screw into the bolt catch pin hole on the lower receiver until driver clutch disengages
key_points: Hold driver perpendicular to prevent cross-threading

transcript.text: Right hand drives the first screw into the receiver using the electric screwdriver
Right hand lifts the electric screwdriver
Right hand positions the electric screwdriver onto the adjacent screw
Right hand presses down the electric screwdriver to drive the screw into the receiver
Right hand lifts the electric screwdriver off the assembly

steps.title: Release electric screwdriver
steps.description: Release the suspended screwdriver so it retracts overhead

transcript.text: Right hand releases the electric screwdriver

steps.title: Remove receiver from fixture
steps.description: Lift the lower receiver out of the left assembly fixture

transcript.text: Both hands lift the receiver assembly from the fixture
Right hand releases the receiver

steps.title: Grab castle nut
steps.description: Walk to center station and pick one black castle nut from bin L9

transcript.text: Left hand places the assembled unit onto the workbench
Right hand reaches into the blue bin containing black castle nuts
Right hand grasps a black castle nut and lifts it out of the bin

steps.title: Grab buffer tube
steps.description: Reach into box L3 with left hand and retrieve one cylindrical black buffer tube

transcript.text: Left hand brings the buffer tube down toward the mounting jig

steps.title: Thread castle nut on buffer tube
steps.description: Place buffer tube into vertical fixture L4 and start the castle nut onto the threads by hand
key_points: Ensure castle nut orientation has notches facing rear

transcript.text: Both hands align the castle nut onto the top of the buffer tube
Right hand threads the castle nut clockwise down onto the buffer tube

steps.title: Grab hanging nut runner
steps.description: Reach up with right hand and pull down the hanging pneumatic nut runner

transcript.text: Right hand reaches up toward the hanging nut runner
Right hand grasps the hanging nut runner

steps.title: Run castle nut down tube
steps.description: Apply nut runner socket onto the castle nut and spin it down the buffer tube threads
key_points: Run nut completely to base of threaded section

transcript.text: Right hand lowers the driver socket onto the castle nut
Right hand pushes down on the driver to run the castle nut down the tube
Left hand releases the tube

steps.title: Release nut runner
steps.description: Release the nut runner to let it retract overhead

transcript.text: Right hand releases the hanging nut runner

steps.title: Grab and slide end plate
steps.description: Pick a black receiver end plate from bin L8 and slide it onto the buffer tube against the castle nut
key_points: Index tab on end plate must align with bottom slot

transcript.text: Left hand reaches into the cardboard box
Left hand grasps a black end plate
Both hands orient the end plate
Both hands slide the end plate onto the vertical cylinder on the fixture

steps.title: Remove buffer tube from fixture
steps.description: Lift the assembled buffer tube and lower receiver together off fixture L4

transcript.text: Right hand grasps the buffer tube in the fixture
Right hand lifts the buffer tube up out of the fixture

steps.title: Thread buffer tube into receiver
steps.description: Thread the buffer tube into the rear ring of the lower receiver until close to the buffer retainer hole
key_points: Do not overtighten past buffer retainer recess

transcript.text: Right hand turns the buffer tube into the rear of the receiver to thread it in while left hand holds the receiver
Right hand releases the buffer tube

steps.title: Pick buffer retainer and spring
steps.description: Pick one small coil spring and one buffer retainer pin from bin L10

transcript.text: Left hand places the lower receiver onto the work surface
Right hand reaches into the middle blue bin of springs
Left hand reaches into the second blue bin from the left
Right hand takes a spring and left hand takes a part
Both hands bring the spring and part together
Left hand returns the part to the leftmost blue bin
Right hand reaches into the middle blue bin of springs
Left hand picks a buffer retainer from the leftmost blue bin
Right hand picks a spring from the middle blue bin
Both hands bring the buffer retainer and spring together
Right hand slides the spring onto the buffer retainer held in the left hand

steps.title: Install buffer retainer and tube
steps.description: Place retainer spring and pin into receiver well, depress pin, and screw buffer tube forward over pin collar
key_points: Keep retainer pin depressed while threading tube lip over the rim

transcript.text: Left hand positions the buffer retainer and spring into the hole at the rear of the receiver
Left hand presses down on the buffer retainer pin
Right hand turns the buffer tube to capture the retainer
Right hand screws and aligns the buffer tube while left hand holds the receiver
Both hands lift the assembled receiver from the workbench

steps.title: Check buffer retainer retention
steps.description: Inspect and verify buffer retainer pin is captured and springs freely
key_points: Retainer must not pop out when released

transcript.text: Right index finger presses the buffer retainer inside the receiver to check retention
Left hand rests the lower receiver assembly upright on the table and releases it
Right hand reaches into the blue bin of small black parts

steps.title: Pick takedown detent and spring
steps.description: Pick one takedown pin detent and one small detent spring from bin L10

transcript.text: Right hand picks a small detent pin from the third compartment of the blue divided tray
Right hand positions the detent pin at the small hole at the rear of the receiver
Right hand inserts the detent pin into the rear hole
Right hand presses the detent pin into the hole
Right hand reaches into the second compartment of the blue divided tray
Right hand picks a spring from the compartment

steps.title: Insert takedown detent and spring
steps.description: Insert takedown pin detent followed by the spring into the rear receiver channel
key_points: Ensure detent pin goes in pointed-end first

transcript.text: Right hand picks a takedown spring from the middle blue bin
Right hand brings the spring to the rear of the lower receiver
Right hand inserts the spring into the detent channel hole at the back of the receiver
Right hand releases the spring and reaches back towards the bins

steps.title: Push end plate over spring
steps.description: Slide the end plate forward against the rear of receiver, compressing and capturing the detent spring
key_points: Ensure spring is not kinked or bent during plate closure

transcript.text: Right hand reaches into the blue bin on the table
Right hand picks up a small silver pin
Right hand uses the pin to push the detent spring into the rear of the receiver
Push the end plate forward over the spring
Right hand withdraws the silver pin
Right hand presses the end plate firmly flush against the receiver
Right hand releases the end plate

steps.title: Hand-tighten castle nut
steps.description: Turn castle nut forward clockwise against the end plate until hand tight
key_points: Ensure end plate remains seated flush against receiver

transcript.text: Right hand turns the castle nut down the buffer tube
Right hand grasps the buffer tube and screws it into the lower receiver
Right hand screws the castle nut down against the end plate until hand-tight
Both hands tilt the receiver assembly horizontally

steps.title: Move receiver to right fixture
steps.description: Pick up receiver assembly and transfer it rightward to lower receiver fixture L11

transcript.text: Both hands lower the receiver assembly onto the fixture block
Both hands press the receiver assembly down onto the fixture block

steps.title: Grab and lubricate buffer spring
steps.description: Retrieve one long recoil buffer spring from box L13 and dip the lead coil into lubricant cup L12
key_points: Coat outer tip of spring evenly in lubricant

transcript.text: Right hand reaches into the cardboard box and lifts out a buffer spring
Left hand holds the green cup to stabilize it
Right hand dips the end of the spring into the green lubricant cup
Right hand lifts the spring out of the cup

steps.title: Grab buffer weight
steps.description: Reach to top shelf bin L14 with right hand and grasp one steel buffer weight

transcript.text: Right hand reaches into the right blue bin on the shelf above
Right hand grasps and removes a buffer weight
Right hand brings the buffer weight to the spring held in the left hand
Right hand inserts the buffer weight into the end of the spring
Both hands push the buffer weight into the spring

steps.title: Assemble buffer weight to spring
steps.description: Push the tail end of the buffer weight into the lubricated front end of the buffer spring
key_points: Press until collar snaps securely over spring coil

transcript.text: Right hand positions the buffer weight at the right end of the spring held in the left hand
Right hand inserts the buffer weight into the end of the spring
Both hands push and twist the spring onto the buffer weight until seated

steps.title: Insert buffer and spring into tube
steps.description: Slide buffer spring assembly into receiver buffer tube until buffer latches behind retainer pin
key_points: Confirm buffer clicks past the buffer retainer pin

transcript.text: Both hands push the buffer and spring into the buffer tube
Right hand presses the buffer past the buffer retainer
Release the buffer and lower receiver

steps.title: Aside assembled receiver
steps.description: Place finished lower receiver assembly on fixture L11 and release

transcript.text: Left hand places the assembled receiver into the rack beneath the workbench

notes:
Handheld camera angles shifted frequently around the operator's shoulder, occasionally obstructing fine manipulation of detent pins between 00:37 and 00:41.
Layout: Camera moved dynamically around the operator; bins and fixtures were mapped based on their positions relative to the operator facing the workbench.

layout.label: Bin of detent springs and pins
